//: Schema file for the universal-rest-connector against Straza. Every ConnId object class the connector offers is declared here, the reserved __ACCOUNT__ and __GROUP__ included: nothing about Straza lives in the connector's Java. Unified role model (scim-profile revision 12): the SCIM group render is THE role projection, and 'role' feed events drive it.
//dialect: The 'dialect' key picks the protocol mechanics. 'json' (the default) is plain REST over the admin API; 'scim' is RFC 7643 and 7644, which the /scim/v2 surface speaks.
//readonly: Read-only is the default: creatable and updateable are false unless declared, and 'operations' defaults to search plus sync when the class has a sync block. The evidence classes app and user declare no write operation.
//sync: The top-level 'sync' block is the change-feed transport, and each object class's 'sync' block routes feed records.

target.name: Straza
target.credentialHint: Mint one with strazactl api-token create --scope scim:read,scim:write,identity:read,apps:read,changes:read,config:read, then check the token's scope covers the resource you are reading or writing.

objects.//syncNote: apps.deployed/removed change events carry the app UID (the uuid id, the same value as GET /v1/admin/apps.id), so create/update re-fetch and delete all key by uid.

user + assignment changes surface as identity events keyed to the user uuid (self); assignment CRUD re-syncs the subject, re-deriving ri:roles (membership changes emit 'user' events for the affected holder at revision 12). Hard deletes surface as type 'identity' → delete.

objects.//: Full user lifecycle over the SCIM 2.0 surface. Uid is the SCIM id, name is userName.
objects.//enable: ConnId __ENABLE__ maps to the SCIM active attribute and is never itself a wire path.
objects.//revive: A create against a previously deactivated userName answers 201 with the SAME id (the profile's revive). The engine takes a new object's uid from the create response, so the revived id is adopted with no key to declare.
objects.//agentic: On create only, and only when the outgoing userType is agent or service, the IETF agentic-SCIM URN joins the schemas array so the server stores kind=nhi. The mark is create-only and unrecoverable, so it is never sent for a human or for an absent userType.

attributes.//typology: The server reads an absent typology field in a PUT as leave alone, so clearing one is a PATCH remove.
attributes.//readonly: Membership reflection, the lock block and the Straza-born facts are declared read-only so midPoint never writes them.

objects.//: A wire-group IS an exported Straza role. Uid is the role id, name is the role name, and membership is the one writable fact.
objects.//lifecycle: No create and no delete: roles are born in Straza and the IdM imports them and assigns membership. The name is left read-only, so a rename is refused before it reaches the wire.
objects.//hints: What a refused verb tells the operator. The connector supplies the refusal, this file supplies the half only Straza knows.

operationHints.create: Roles are born in Straza, and the identity manager imports them and assigns membership.
operationHints.delete: Roles are deleted in Straza, and the identity manager drops the membership it assigned.
operationHints.rename: Roles are renamed in Straza, and the new name arrives with the next import.

attributes.//projection: The read-only access projection (spec/scim-profile section 4.1) with clean ConnId names. The role-to-app association rides apps.

objects.//syncNote: A role change or a membership change emits a role event. A binding change reshapes the projection's apps and tools without an own role event, so the class re-emits on it.
